name: Launch video
blurb: Script, storyboard, produce and post a short launch video, from the first line to the caption.
description: Make a short launch or promo video end to end from one request: script, shot list and storyboard, production plan and route (AI generation, editing or motion), captions and delivery checks, then the post and caption for social, using the Skill Garden storyboarding, ai-video and social-media super skills in order. Use when asked to make a launch video, promo, reel or short ad video for a product or feature.
ask: Make a launch video for <product or feature> for <platform>.
inputs: What is launching and the one thing viewers should remember
Assets you have: screen recordings, footage, logo, music
Tools you can use for generation or editing
Voice: narrated, captions only, or on-camera

steps.title: Write the script
steps.output: A script with a hook in the first two seconds and one idea per scene.

steps.title: Shot list and storyboard
steps.output: A numbered shot list with framing, motion and on-screen text.

steps.title: Plan and produce the video
steps.output: The production route per shot and the prompts or edit steps to make it.

steps.title: Captions and delivery checks
steps.output: Captions and a checklist pass for the platform's specs.

steps.title: Write the post
steps.output: The caption, first comment and posting notes.
